outcome.Summary: Configured the full pipeline on this host: installed git + openssh-server + python3, created a bare repo at /git/server (clone/push URL: <user>@<host>:/git/server) owned by user:gitweb with a post-receive hook that extracts the master branch into /var/www/html (cleaning stale files first), and started a supervised python3 http.server on 0.0.0.0:8080 serving that web root. Both existing accounts (user, ubuntu) are in the gitweb push group, have their shadow entries un-locked so key logins work, and have ready .ssh/authorized_keys files for the user to add their public key; /etc/gitconfig sets safe.directory=* and defaultBranch=master. Verified end-to-end twice (temp key -> git clone over SSH as user@127.0.0.1:/git/server -> commit/push master -> curl :8080/hello.html returned "hello world"), including a supervisor auto-restart check, then reset the repo to empty and removed test keys. See /git/README.md for a summary.
